decision_rule: A match remains no_selection while any evidence gate is false. Exploratory probabilities are recorded for prospective scoring, not treated as selections.
limitations: Domestic form is descriptive and is not an input to the frozen UEFA probability model.
Player badges do not prove match-specific absence, injury severity, or starting status.
No current tactical feature has passed a predictive holdout test.
The results-only UEFA model has not demonstrated a stable edge over current market prices.
